name: faultview
description: FaultView stage 3: static landing and autonomous React MVP

scripts.setup: npm --prefix apps/frontend ci && npm --prefix apps/landing ci && npm --prefix examples ci --ignore-scripts && npm run hooks:install && npm run setup:examples
scripts.dev:all: npm run build && npm run preview
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/frontend run lint && npm --prefix apps/landing run lint && npm run lint:scripts
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run build && npm run test:site && npm run test:examples && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:visual
scripts.lint:scripts: node apps/frontend/node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js scripts examples/tooling examples/pages examples/tests examples/playwright.config.js eslint.config.mjs --max-warnings=0
